analytic_separator.both_ordinary_families_at_one_geometry: excluded within this fixed construction; their necessary A signs are incompatible
analytic_separator.lower_positive_A_region: A>0 below the lower separator is not by itself evidence of a slow solution. Thin unsampled branches there are not excluded by the .125deg map.
analytic_separator.uncertainty: The separator is computed with frozen inputs and closure; numerical digits are not observational angular accuracy.

precision.region: ASSUMED axis-aligned planning box; no covariance/confidence level supplied
precision.interpretation: Strict halfwidth inequalities are sufficient ordinary-family exclusions, not universally optimal measurement requirements.
precision.tilt_only_examples: 45+/-5deg excludes checked slow; 60+/-5deg excludes checked fast, with the other angle left free within the tested ordinary-family construction and central feasibility retained.
precision.field_angle_only_at30deg: insufficient even at zero error: checked fast(45,30) and slow(60,30)
precision.field_angle_only_at80deg: insufficient even at zero error: checked fast(45,80) and new checked slow(83.25,80)
precision.existence_vs_whole_box: A discriminating box retains an admissible witness and excludes the competing ordinary family. Not every geometry in that box must be feasible; neither/guard regions remain unclassified.

limits: R131 assumptions and observational reductions remain fixed.
A box is a planning region, not a measured confidence region.
718 guarded map locations and .125deg unresolved boundary cells retain their labels; analytic family exclusion does not relabel them.
Sampled uniform cells are not interval-certified; no claim of global completeness of the continuous sampled map.
No observed E05 fast shock, slow shock, or pair of waves is identified.
Multiple roots are alternatives, not probabilities.
